$comment: Fallback catalogue, used when the backend is unreachable. The backend serves this same shape from Firestore and recomputes every price server-side at checkout — nothing here is trusted for payment. All prices are in minor units (pence).

artworks.description: A square canvas worked entirely in flat, hand-cut triangles — no gradients, no blending, every edge painted to a line. The tessellation folds back on itself as it repeats, so it reads as one kaleidoscope from across a room and comes apart into separate facets up close. Primary red, cobalt and yellow carry the grid; magenta, purple and orange break it. A single black-and-white flame sits low and to the right, the one place the colour stops.

hero.alt: A square canvas covered edge to edge in flat painted triangles — red, cobalt, yellow, green, magenta, purple and orange — repeating as a kaleidoscope, with one black-and-white flame motif low on the right.

insitu.alt: The same canvas hanging on a white studio wall, roughly as tall as the wall panel behind it, showing its scale.

details.alt: Close detail: a fan of cobalt and pale blue triangles opening into yellow and green.
Close detail: the tessellation repeating, with smaller triangles nested inside the larger ones.
Close detail: the black-and-white flame motif, the only part of the canvas without colour.
